title: Every call crashes before the pipeline starts
problem: The later import of load_brief_into_ctx inside run_sophia_agent makes the name local throughout the function. Its first use raises UnboundLocalError, including calls with no lead. This masks nearly every downstream defect.
fix: Keep one module-level import. Regression-test both inbound and outbound initialization through pipeline startup with provider stubs.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Call ID is substituted for the media stream ID
problem: The serializer is created with call_sid as stream_sid. Outbound start handling reads callSid and discards streamSid; the existing _read_stream_sid helper is never called. Installed serializer ignores start events, so it does not correct the ID. The clear frame reproduction targets the wrong stream; outbound audio uses the same configured identifier.
fix: Parse one start event, retain callSid, streamSid and mediaFormat separately, and pass the real stream ID to the serializer. Test emitted media and clear against the captured start event.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Speech chunker defeats streaming
problem: All speech text is accumulated until LLMFullResponseEndFrame, even after SentenceStreamProcessor has emitted a complete sentence. The first-sentence streaming benefit is erased. Silent wait now includes full model generation, not just time to the first useful sentence.
fix: Use one aggregation layer with bounded incremental sentence forwarding. Test that first TTS text arrives before model completion.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Interrupted responses contaminate the next answer
problem: Neither SpeechChunker nor SentenceStreamProcessor clears pending text on InterruptionFrame. A stopped answer reappears in the next response. The stress reproduction leaked STALE text in 1,000 of 1,000 cycles.
fix: Clear generation-local buffers on interruption, cancellation, new generation and disconnect; reject old generation IDs. Add interleaved frame-order tests.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Custom turn controller sits after the component that consumes transcripts
problem: TurnController evaluates TranscriptionFrame but is downstream of the user context aggregator. Pipecat 1.12 consumes final/interim transcripts there, then emits context frames. Its intended suppression and emotional decisions cannot inspect the normal transcription flow at this position.
fix: Move transcript policy before aggregation, or implement supported user-turn strategies inside the aggregator. Verify observed frame types in the real assembled pipeline.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: STT mute travels away from the STT service
problem: BotSpeakingSTTMuteProcessor precedes STT, yet emits STTMuteFrame upstream. That frame reaches transport rather than the downstream STT service. Echo protection is therefore miswired. Moving it carelessly can instead disable legitimate barge-in.
fix: Use framework mute strategies and a tested echo/interruption policy. Instrument the STT receiver and prove mute/unmute direction plus real seller interruptions.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Spanish recognition remains English
problem: Spanish mode computes and logs es but supplies en-US to Deepgram settings. The LLM can be told to speak Spanish while recognition continues in English; TTS also remains an English voice by default.
fix: Apply a supported Spanish or multilingual recognizer and language-appropriate synthesis. Test Spanish and code switching with actual audio.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Pipecat settings silently disappear on the unpinned install
problem: With installed Pipecat 1.12, PipelineParams drops aggregation_timeout and allow_interruptions from its parsed model. The apparent configuration does not mean those behaviors were applied. Actual defaults may still support interruptions; this is a silent configuration mismatch, not proof that interruptions are entirely disabled.
fix: Choose and lock a Pipecat release; use its supported aggregator/turn settings. Test the resolved configuration, not source keyword presence.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Declared provider selection is disconnected from the live provider
problem: The live agent hardcodes Deepgram TTS, while ProviderRegistry selects Cartesia/Orpheus/ElevenLabs and the settings UI presents Cartesia as Sophia voice. Provider health/failover infrastructure is not used by the live construction path.
fix: Expose the actual active provider/model/voice; implement and exercise one explicit fallback path. Remove configuration that cannot affect calls.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Artificial think delays accumulate per chunk
problem: The processor sleeps before every text frame. Calm speech adds 50–120ms per chunk: twelve chunks add 0.6–1.44 seconds of scheduled delay alone. These are code-derived bounds, not measured end-to-end call latency.
fix: Remove delays while establishing latency baseline. If retained, apply a bounded turn-level cadence policy measured against audio playback.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: A synthetic breath is prepended on every synthesis start
problem: Each TTSStartedFrame causes 150ms of random-noise PCM to be pushed before the start frame. Multiple syntheses in a response can add repeated noise/gaps. This is a deterministic injected duration; whether it is audible requires captured phone playback.
fix: Disable by default and A/B the raw provider output. If retained, use validated audio and consistent speech lifecycle ordering.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Audio filtering depends on packet boundaries
problem: Presence filter state resets for each frame; high-pass input continuity also resets. The same synthetic 700Hz signal processed whole versus in 20ms packets differs substantially. This can produce boundary artifacts and inconsistent sound; the microbenchmark is not a perceptual rating.
fix: Remove EQ for a raw-audio baseline or use a streaming filter preserving all state. Test packet-boundary invariance and inspect real recordings.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Per-sample DSP blocks the async audio loop
problem: High-pass, presence and compression run Python loops synchronously inside process_frame. The included local benchmark measures serial CPU cost for 1/3/10 synthetic streams, not server capacity. DB and other blocking work can compound jitter.
fix: Use vectorized/stateful DSP off the critical event loop only if A/B tests justify the filter. Measure event-loop lag and audio underruns under concurrent calls.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Spoken stage directions survive cleanup
problem: The runtime prompt asks for lowercase [laughter] and [sympathetic], but the bracket remover matches uppercase labels. Both lowercase tags survive _transform. Actual provider treatment remains untested; literal words or unnatural prosody are a plausible audible symptom.
fix: Use supported provider controls or remove stage directions before TTS; test every prompt-generated tag.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Acknowledgment splitting can change meaning
problem: The regex splits ordinary occurrences of right, sure and yeah without sentence-level intent. Directional or contextual uses can become separate acknowledgments. Chunk boundaries are word counts rather than prosodic units.
fix: Preserve natural sentences and punctuation. Test addresses, right-of-way, price conditions, negations and short answers against the final TTS text.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Backchannel suppression has unreachable branches
problem: The first _BACKCHANNEL_ONLY match returns False, so later matching branches that return True cannot execute. A direct okay case passes. This is separate from the controller being placed too late in the pipeline.
fix: Define when acknowledgment means turn completion versus continuation and use one decision branch with positive/negative tests.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Backchannels do not use a dedicated realtime path
problem: Generated TTSTextFrame acknowledgments travel through later aggregation/text processors and the full-response buffer. Interim transcript hypotheses can repeatedly inflate word counts. startup_clips are explicitly discarded in run_sophia_agent.
fix: Implement short acknowledgments with generation-aware playback and deduplicated interim hypotheses; test while the seller is still speaking.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Interruption acknowledgment is instantiated but not wired
problem: InterruptionAckProcessor is constructed but never appears in the Pipeline list. Its existence and tests do not give live calls its behavior.
fix: Remove the unused component or insert it only after proving it does not talk over the user. Test the actual pipeline processor list.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Pipeline safety assertion examines freshly created substitutes
problem: The check is handed new AISoftener/FairHousing/Compliance instances rather than the assembled full pipeline. It cannot prove the actual filters are present, ordered correctly or on every speaking path.
fix: Validate the real list and all TTSSpeak/text paths; add a failing test that deliberately removes or reorders a required processor.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: First outbound seller statement is swallowed
problem: When the opener has not fired, the first transcription increments/analyzes state and returns without forwarding it. Ownership and DNC handling later in the method are skipped. A meaningful first response, wrong-number statement or stop request can be lost to downstream logic.
fix: Treat opener delivery and seller turns independently. Preserve the utterance, run safety handling immediately and avoid replaying it as a fabricated new turn.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Greeting can wait behind enrichment and competing opener triggers
problem: Outbound context/enrichment work is done before starting the agent, then an opener can fire from first seller text or a three-second delayed task. The flag reduces duplicate greetings but does not make enrichment latency or untracked task lifecycle safe.
fix: Start transport and an authenticated minimal greeting promptly; load optional enrichment with bounded deadlines and cancel opener tasks on disconnect.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Codec and sample-rate configuration needs a captured boundary test
problem: Transport/TTS use explicit 8k output and STT uses 16k input, while PipelineParams defaults resolve to 16k input/24k output on the audit install. Resampling can be legitimate. No captured mediaFormat/PCM/provider session proves which conversion actually occurs in deployment.
fix: Assert mediaFormat, decoder rate, STT rate, TTS frame rate and encoder rate end to end. Use a known tone to prove correct duration/pitch and raw mu-law framing; do not infer corruption from rate differences alone.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Slotted context cannot store required conversation state
problem: owner_confirmed, _dnc_flagged, pre_close_done and appointment_set are absent from a dataclass(slots=True). Writes raise AttributeError; reads default to False. Owner/DNC branches write missing slots, while pre-close/appointment progress cannot be represented as intended.
fix: Declare typed fields and update them through explicit state transitions. Test ownership, DNC, pre-close agreement and booking with real CallContext instances.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Runtime instructions are applied to the previous user message
problem: ContextTracker updates the last user message before the downstream aggregator has appended the current utterance. First-turn context may not be injected at all. AnalysisCallbacks then produces additional instructions after injection, making current-turn safety/objective guidance late or overwritten.
fix: Build one current-turn state snapshot after analysis, before LLM generation, and supply it at the correct instruction level. Test message ordering and first-turn behavior.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Property context is computed and discarded
problem: _load_system_prompt reads property_context_str and builds intel_slice but returns only base_prompt. Injecting a unique address into call_context does not put it in the system prompt. Useful facts can exist in DB/preloader without reaching the model.
fix: Use a bounded, typed property context in the live prompt and assert sentinel facts reach the model request.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Runtime ARV and MAO lookup references nonexistent self._ctx
problem: CallContext.build_context_prefix accesses self._ctx, catches the resulting error and silently omits property numbers. A populated property_profile does not produce the expected ARV/MAO lines. Other intel slice sections may still appear; the specific property lookup is broken.
fix: Read self.intel_packet directly with a validated property schema and explicit units. Assert known ARV/MAO/address appear exactly once.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Seller memory is loaded but not attached to live prompt state
problem: Preloader returns memory_context_str, but agent never copies it into CallContext.memory_context_str. Outbound uses a conditional reference to an undefined memory_context_str that resolves to an empty string. Post-call update_from_intel does exist, so the primary break is consumption, not absence of all memory extraction.
fix: Pass the preloaded memory into context and verify remembered price, objection and agreed next step in the actual LLM request on a second call.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Transcript is reconstructed from trimmed LLM context
problem: The live history is trimmed to eight non-system messages. At call end _build_transcript reads that same context, so early conversation can be permanently absent from stored transcript/chunks and QA. No independent full-turn journal is used in this path.
fix: Maintain append-only transcript events independent of the prompt window. Test a 20-turn conversation retains all turns after multiple trims.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Transcript contains internal context instructions
problem: _build_transcript copies string user content verbatim, including <ctx> runtime instructions and <seller> wrappers injected by ContextTracker. These can be stored as seller speech and distort QA/extraction.
fix: Record original transcript frames separately; strip internal metadata before any transcript export or grading.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: History truncation can break tool-message protocol
problem: Trimming arbitrary messages can separate assistant tool_use blocks from user tool_result blocks. Compression is checked only above 16 messages, while normal per-turn trimming keeps eight, so long-history summarization is usually unreachable.
fix: Trim complete conversational/tool transactions and preserve a structured summary plus durable facts. Test tool calls at the window boundary.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Street numbers, years and loan balances become asking prices
problem: The broad numeric regex converts 1234 Main Street to 123400 cents and a 2010 purchase year to 201000 cents; a loan balance also becomes last_price_mentioned. Downstream pricing/conflict behavior then operates on the wrong entity.
fix: Extract typed monetary entities with contextual role and confirmation. Test asking price versus debt, address, year, phone number and correction.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Negations reverse intent and agent status
problem: I don't want to sell it matches selling intent; I do not have an agent matches has_agent. These facts latch and are not corrected by subsequent explicit negation.
fix: Use explicit positive/negative/corrected states with confidence and original evidence. Add paired negation tests and revision tests.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: No rush is classified as rushed
problem: no rush, not in a hurry, whenever and flexible are included in the rushed pattern. This changes tone, objectives and timing in the wrong direction.
fix: Separate urgency evidence from relaxed timeline evidence and avoid deriving emotional state from one keyword.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Numeric-only meaningful replies can be discarded as noise
problem: A one-token numeric STT reply is dropped, including a price such as 200000 or a time fragment. Whether STT emits that shape depends on recognition settings, which enable numerals.
fix: Make noise filtering context-aware; preserve numbers when asking price, time or address. Test native STT outputs, not only handwritten prose.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Collected address is only a Boolean
problem: The tracker detects address-shaped text but only sets address_known. It does not persist the literal address or resolve/update a property record; a model is still expected to recover it from a short history window.
fix: Persist a confirmed structured address and associate the right property/lead before pricing or booking.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Objective progression can wrap a hot lead before booking
problem: Any HOT/WARM/COLD/DEAD disposition forces wrap. HOT can be assigned for merely asking about price or process. Qualification also bypasses facts after four turns, and missing pre_close_done/appointment_set prevent normal progress. Two Bob phase maps disagree.
fix: Use one state machine separating classification from conversation completion; require recorded consent and concrete booking before appointment success.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Bob escalation contract is dropped at load time
problem: CallBrief serializes escalation, but loader reads escalation_rules. Generated escalation guidance disappears despite a successful call_brief_loaded log.
fix: Use the same validated contract on producer and consumer; test every field survives a round trip.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Orchestrator outcomes are partly decorative
problem: Any call_should_end reason is labeled silence_timeout. response_length_cap is produced but not applied. Runtime objective/instruction updates occur after context injection and compete with ObjectiveEngine updates.
fix: Give one coordinator ownership of turn decisions; enforce caps and propagate a typed termination reason through persistence and telephony.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Snapshots have no restoration path
problem: AnalysisCallbacks can save snapshots, but no backend consumer calls load_snapshot or delete_snapshot. Snapshot existence does not supply reconnect/recovery behavior; missing redis dependency also disables it.
fix: Either implement bounded same-session recovery with generation safety or remove the implied recovery feature. Test disconnect/reconnect explicitly.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: End-call handler references an undefined task
problem: _make_tool_handler is a separate function and has no task closure/parameter. When call_should_end is set, it waits 1.5 seconds then raises NameError. Returning an end_call tool result does not actually terminate the phone conversation through this handler.
fix: Bind the real pipeline/telephony termination callback and make termination idempotent. Test cancellation and persisted reason after each exit path.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Failed SMS sends are announced as sent
problem: _send_offer_summary and _send_followup_sms ignore send_sms False. Outside-hours, provider and DB logging errors can produce false seller confirmations. The follow-up helper also inserts a second SMS record without provider delivery proof.
fix: Return structured accepted/failed/delivered states, use one logging owner and speak success only after the relevant acknowledgment.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Invalid appointments advance the lead stage
problem: Invalid date/time falls back to display text, then marks walkthrough_booked and returns Appointment booked even though appointment_at is not written. There is no availability reservation, past-time rejection or seller/owner schedule validation.
fix: Validate timezone/date/time and availability before atomic booking. Reject invalid inputs without stage changes; reserve and confirm an actual appointment ID.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Missing price becomes an invented email offer
problem: _collect_and_send_email supplies $150,000–$175,000 defaults when approved prices are missing. The number is not derived from property data or authority. This can turn a request for written information into an unsupported financial offer.
fix: Never default an offer price. Require a signed/approved offer record and immutable monetary units before transmitting it.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Voicemail tool claims an action it never performs
problem: _drop_voicemail only chooses a string and logs it. There is no voicemail provider request or playback acknowledgment. The active-call voicemail detection route is a separate implementation.
fix: Return draft_only or implement a real supported action; make action and script generation distinct.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Model-supplied lead IDs and destinations are not bound to the call
problem: The gate prefers tool_input.lead_id and tool implementations accept arbitrary lead IDs, phones and email addresses. A confused or adversarial conversation can target a different lead/destination using server-side privileges.
fix: Inject trusted lead/call/destination bindings server-side; reject model attempts to override them and log the mismatch.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Missing intel packet opens gated tools by default
problem: If intel_packet is absent, the gate allows gated tools. Non-listed tools are also automatically allowed. The call-context kill_switch_active is not checked by tool preflight even though speech output reacts to it.
fix: Use explicit fail-closed permissions for side effects, including kill switches, while allowing bounded informational fallback.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Permission levels are not strongly tied to each authorized action
problem: Preflight blocks blocked/ask_operator_required but otherwise trusts a level label. Approval resolution sets the level book_appointment for any requested action. This is not a durable action/amount/scope authorization contract.
fix: Validate action-specific permission, scope, lead binding, expiry and monetary ceiling before every side effect; reject unknown levels.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Operator approval does not clear the state that keeps blocking
problem: _resolve_approval mutates packet_state and a permission but leaves conflict_active/fallback_mode intact. The earlier gate branches can still block an approved action. API-resolved approvals are not automatically consumed by the live context refresh path.
fix: Implement one approval state transition that resolves the conflict condition, records authority and notifies the active call. Test approval through API/SMS to actual retried tool.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Operator queries and approval requests are separate disconnected flows
problem: ask_operator creates/polls operator_queries, while governance uses approval_requests. It can wait up to 90 seconds in a worker thread without a clear framework speech/liveness policy. A reply alone is not a replay of the blocked action.
fix: Unify request IDs and transitions; use async notification plus a bounded seller fallback. Test late replies, cancellation and duplicate replies.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Dollar/cents mismatch creates false intel conflicts
problem: Assembler converts ARV and seller price floor from cents to dollars, then calls a detector using a 3,000,000 cents threshold. A $140,000 spread is flagged thin. Normal deals can be forced into conflict/approval handling.
fix: Keep canonical cents in all contracts; convert only at presentation boundaries. Add dimensional assertions and clean/conflicted fixtures.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Packet freshness is rewritten without proof of fresh evidence
problem: Property values loaded from existing rows are labeled comps and updated_at now. Packet assembly time is not the evidence acquisition time. A recently assembled packet can present old comps as current.
fix: Preserve source retrieval timestamps, confidence, provenance and expiry independently of packet build/version time.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Initial packet load does not enforce safe_for_live_call
problem: Initial agent loading accepts the packet directly; mid-call refresh has separate safety logic. Safety acceptance therefore differs depending on when the same packet is read.
fix: Use one validated packet acceptance function for preload, initial load and refresh; test malformed/stale/operator-locked packets.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Packet versions and approval idempotency need concurrent DB verification
problem: The source relies on application-level read/write steps for evolving packets and requests. The repository lacks the relevant table/constraint migrations, so atomicity, unique idempotency keys and retry behavior cannot be proven from it.
fix: Create explicit constraints and atomic version compare-and-swap/transactions. Stress concurrent assembly, duplicate approval and expiry renewal against an isolated database.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Regex output checks miss speaking paths and split phrases
problem: Filters inspect text frames but not TTSSpeakFrame used for openers/recovery. Checks are applied after chunking, so a prohibited phrase can be split across chunks. No final numeric authority clamp validates every spoken price.
fix: Validate complete proposed utterances and all direct-speech paths before playback; preserve streaming with rolling semantic boundaries and enforce structured offer authority.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Identity policy contradicts itself
problem: Runtime prompt tells Sophia to evade AI questions while AIIdentityProcessor requests an automated-assistant disclosure. Late/overwritten instructions worsen this conflict. This is a product trust/policy inconsistency; no legal compliance conclusion is made here.
fix: Choose one truthful identity policy and test direct and indirect AI questions in live prompt/audio paths. Remove biographical claims that the assistant cannot substantiate.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Direct dial permits closed/noncallable leads and future callbacks
problem: call_lead does not reject callable=False or terminal stage and only logs a future callback timestamp before dialing. With providers mocked, a closed/noncallable lead scheduled in 2099 still invokes _make_call.
fix: Centralize eligibility at the final side-effect boundary. Queue-level filtering is insufficient; test all entry points against the same eligibility policy.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Concurrent limit admits twelve calls against a limit of three
problem: Redis count is read before a separate zadd. Twelve synchronized workers each see room and all acquire a slot. The test uses a deterministic fake Redis to force the actual code interleaving; no live Redis was exercised.
fix: Use atomic Lua/transactional capacity and per-lead reservation with ownership tokens. Test real Redis under concurrency and crash cleanup.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Same-lead protection checks only global capacity
problem: _check_active_call receives lead_id but only checks total count. A duplicate call to an already active lead is allowed below capacity. Slots keyed by lead can overwrite one another and release an overlapping session incorrectly.
fix: Reserve lead and call IDs atomically, with a unique owner token for release; require terminal provider status before releasing.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Redis is optional, absent from requirements, and fails open
problem: redis is imported dynamically but is not declared in requirements.txt. Missing configuration/import or Redis errors cause slot acquisition to return True and active-call checks False. The documented three-call protection disappears silently.
fix: Declare and verify the dependency; make the scheduler refuse outbound work when reservation infrastructure is unavailable.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Stale call-slot expiration is doubled
problem: Slots are scored now+900, but cleanup removes scores <=now-900. An unreleased slot survives roughly 30 minutes, rather than 15. Fixed expiry also lacks a heartbeat for legitimately long calls.
fix: Store true expiration and compare with now, renew active leases, and reconcile against provider terminal state.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Sophia loop permanently fills an in-process active set
problem: Successful calls add lead IDs (twice) and no code removes them. After three distinct successful leads, future runs break at the concurrency check until the process restarts. This also stops SMS/drip branches because the check precedes channel execution.
fix: Use the shared session lease system and release in terminal/finally paths; test two scheduler cycles after simulated completions.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Retry delay exists only in a log
problem: The computed 30-minute/4-hour/24-hour delay is never passed to create_followup. The resulting task has no corresponding scheduled_at and may be picked up on the next poll.
fix: Persist due_at and retry attempt count atomically; honor both in dispatch and cap retries across callbacks/restarts.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Follow-up poller ignores task type, due time and completion
problem: Every returned pending followup is sent to call_lead, including walkthrough/non-call tasks. There is no due-time check, claim/lease or complete_followup call. A task can remain pending and repeat indefinitely.
fix: Dispatch by type, claim only due tasks atomically, and record completed/retry/failed states tied to a provider outcome.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Callback poller skips answered callers and clears failed work
problem: Due callbacks exclude leads whose last_call_outcome is answered, which includes people who requested a callback during a successful conversation. Callback timestamps are cleared regardless of call_lead success.
fix: Use explicit due callback job state independent of last call outcome. Clear only after a successfully accepted dispatch or deliberate operator cancellation.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Campaign pause does not govern the callers
problem: Pause/resume endpoints do exist and update campaigns, but run_campaign, Sophia loop and final call_lead do not consult that state. The dashboard can report paused while scheduled calls continue.
fix: Check an authoritative campaign/global pause immediately before every outbound side effect; test a pause racing with queued work.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Redial endpoint counts leads without queuing them
problem: The endpoint only selects and returns IDs. No queue insert or dispatch occurs, despite leads_queued and success labels. It also uses no_answer while provider dispositions use no-answer in other paths.
fix: Create durable deduplicated call jobs and return their IDs/status; normalize provider and internal disposition vocabularies.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Every application process starts its own schedulers
problem: Lifespan starts several in-memory schedulers with process-local max_instances. Replicas/workers can dispatch the same job independently, and date-based speed-to-lead jobs vanish on restart. Current Railway command has one worker; the replication failure is a deployment scaling risk.
fix: Separate durable scheduling from serving; use one leased dispatcher or transactional work queue and startup reconciliation.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Speed-to-lead advances attempts before confirming delivery
problem: The normal API does start this scheduler indirectly through start_drip_scheduler. However, _run_touch increments attempts before confirming dial or SMS success, and touch 5 marks completed before its provider action. Blocked hours, missing phone or failed sends can advance the sequence without successful contact.
fix: Persist each touch as pending/accepted/failed and advance based on a verified action result. Test failed/outside-hours/missing-phone touches and restart recovery.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Short calls are classified dead without conversation evidence
problem: A completed call under 90 seconds with no human AnsweredBy value is overwritten as dead. A valid brief booking/callback/wrong-recognition case can be killed by duration, while completed also maps to answered and can overwrite voicemail.
fix: Preserve AMD, provider lifecycle and conversational disposition separately; infer no business outcome solely from duration.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Voicemail retry is unreachable in the terminal-status branch
problem: The enclosing terminal-status set excludes voicemail, while retry condition includes it. attempt_count is read from provider form data with default zero and is not an authoritative persisted retry count.
fix: Drive retry eligibility from durable normalized outcome events and persisted attempts; test voicemail/AMD/completed event order.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Recording callback points at the wrong handler
problem: Dial payload uses outbound-status as the recording callback, despite a recording-status/{lead_id} route existing. Recording metadata will not be saved by the intended handler. Even the intended handler updates a call row that is only inserted at call end, creating an event-order race.
fix: Use the dedicated URL and upsert recording events by call ID independently of transcript completion; reconcile late/early callbacks.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: SMS recency uses the wrong timestamp and never refreshes it here
problem: last_called_at or last_sms_at chooses the first populated field rather than the latest contact. send_sms logs a message but does not update lead.last_sms_at. Repeated loop decisions can therefore ignore recent texts.
fix: Compute latest actual contact from durable channel events and update recency atomically. Test recent SMS following an old call.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Missing seller name crashes personalized SMS generation
problem: Empty owner_name is split and indexed at [0] before the try/fallback block. The missing-name reproduction raises IndexError. seller_memory.price_floor is also formatted as dollars here without the cents conversion used by SellerMemory.to_prompt_context.
fix: Use a safe name helper and canonical currency formatter; test empty names and a known cents price floor.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Appointment reminders assert an attendance event that was not recorded
problem: Two hours after an appointment, the scheduler can send We came by/did we miss you based on time/reminder flags alone. The code does not check recorded operator attendance or walkthrough completion before claiming a visit.
fix: Require attendance/completion/no-show state from the operator; only send a neutral check-in when attendance is unknown.
repair_status: Partial; truthful reminders and confirmed-booking filtering repaired; delivery and attendance integration remain

title: Calling-hour defaults differ across subsystems
problem: Default starts are 8 or 9 and ends 20 or 21 across SMS, speed-to-lead, Sophia loop and compliance/dialing. Code and campaign printed descriptions disagree. Shared environment settings can hide the difference; missing configuration exposes it.
fix: Use one configured time policy with timezone/DST behavior and test all channels against it.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: CSV upload passes a stream to a path-only parser
problem: A valid small CSV upload raises TypeError in os.path.exists because parse_csv expects a filesystem path, not StringIO. This occurs before per-row error handling.
fix: Define a stream-based parser or safely stage a temporary path; test actual UploadFile through the route.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: CSV upload expects the wrong scorer return type
problem: calculate_distress_score returns an integer, but upload calls .get and indexes score. After the parser is fixed, rows still fail inside the loop and can produce misleading partial counters.
fix: Use score_properties or a typed score result consistently; test accepted/disqualified rows and the returned counts.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Property upsert does not return the ID needed for lead creation
problem: upsert_property discards DB response and returns None. CSV/scout check prop.id, which the parser does not create. Normal upserted CSV rows therefore cannot reliably create linked leads without reloading the saved property.
fix: Return the canonical property row/ID from upsert, then atomically create/link a lead with a unique property constraint.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: CSV private contact keys are sent to property storage
problem: _owner_phone/_owner_phone_2/_owner_email remain in the property dict during upsert and are popped only later in the lead branch. They are parser transport metadata, not property columns established by repository migrations.
fix: Separate persistence models from ingestion metadata and validate exact table columns before storage.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: CSV scout entry point crashes immediately
problem: A nested datetime/timezone import later in run_scout shadows the module-level names, so its first log raises UnboundLocalError. The main API calls a different run_scout_cycle, which avoids this exception by omitting CSV processing entirely.
fix: Remove shadowing and test both standalone and deployed scheduler entry points.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Deployed scout cycle runs only part of the acquisition system
problem: The cycle invoked by API runs RSS, expired and eviction. It does not run the CSV scout, social, CRMLS, court, tax or cash-buyer paths that exist elsewhere. Feature presence is not proof of scheduled ingestion.
fix: Publish one source registry showing enabled/disabled/manual sources, last success and row counts; schedule explicitly supported sources.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: ARV trigger calls its local get_comps with missing arguments
problem: The active trigger_arv_computation supplies address/sqft but get_comps requires city/state. TypeError is caught and logged, leaving no ARV. An older same-named function is overwritten and contains an undefined pull_comps reference.
fix: Keep one implementation with a typed full subject address and test a provider stub all the way to update_property_arv.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Homeharvest ARV trigger omits the repair buffer from MAO
problem: If its signature bug is fixed, this path stores 70% ARV without subtracting 2,500,000 cents. It conflicts with the repository MAO rule and calculator/offer paths.
fix: Use one integer-cents MAO function for every valuation and offer write; verify identical results across all entry points.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Homeharvest neighborhood search is city-wide
problem: The provider request uses city/state rather than the subject address even though address and radius are available. A radius is not evidence of subject proximity if the geocoding target is the city. Pricing confidence may overstate locality.
fix: Center sold comps on the verified subject coordinates/address and store exact distance/time/property-type filtering evidence.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Offer storage contract conflicts with its migration
problem: SQL creates offer_amount/offer_status; create_offer and update_offer_status write amount/status. Four existing offer tests fail on these missing expected keys. Live DB may have manual columns, but clean repository migration and code disagree.
fix: Choose one versioned offer schema, migrate data and regenerate typed contracts. Test a clean migrated DB rather than mocking any key as valid.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Offer analytics select one status name and read another
problem: get_offer_analytics selects status/amount then reads offer_status, causing rows to fall into draft even if their selected status is accepted/sent. This remains a bug even if manual amount/status columns exist.
fix: Use the canonical field names throughout aggregation and test one row for every lifecycle state.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Clean database bootstrap is incomplete
problem: Migrations mostly ALTER pre-existing properties/leads/calls and create only six tables. Twenty-three table names referenced by Python are not created by tracked migrations, including base tables, intel, approvals, campaigns and provider logs. Deployed DB may contain them; a fresh deployment is not reproducible from this repository.
fix: Add a baseline plus ordered migrations/constraints and run every API/workflow against a disposable freshly migrated instance.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Property/lead relationship is represented inconsistently
problem: Some paths insert lead.property_id and others query properties.lead_id foreign-key joins. Without the baseline schema and atomic linking contract, orphaned or mismatched joins can silently exclude eligible rows.
fix: Choose one ownership relation or enforce both with a transaction/constraint. Test create, merge and lookup in every query path.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Auto-enrichment imports a function that does not exist
problem: The optional enrichment branch imports enrich_lead_realestateapi from batchdata, where the symbol is absent. Its catch converts the failure into a warning and leaves the lead unenriched.
fix: Wire an existing supported provider function with a documented result contract; report per-source failed enrichment as an actionable job state.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Cash-buyer acquisition is disconnected at three imports
problem: get_recent_deed_transfers, upsert_cash_buyer and skip_trace_by_name_address are absent. Fetch catches the import failure and returns an empty list, looking like no available buyers rather than a broken integration.
fix: Implement or remove the advertised feature; expose unavailable versus zero-results distinctly and test producer-to-storage flow.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Residential buyer filter accepts industrial property
problem: The allowed substring tuple contains an empty string, which matches every property_type. An industrial warehouse passes the residential check.
fix: Use an explicit normalized residential enumeration and test unknown/commercial/industrial/mobile types.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Deal-blast property schema disagrees with acquisition schema
problem: Deal blast selects arv/bedrooms/bathrooms while ingestion/preloader/migrations use estimated_arv/beds/baths. This can fail the select or send incomplete details, depending on manual DB schema.
fix: Use shared typed property projections and test one actual migrated property through buyer message rendering.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Comps cache has no age or size bound
problem: In-process comps cache never expires values and grows with distinct subjects. It is not shared across workers, so results differ after restart or by serving instance.
fix: Store fetched_at/source/TTL and size limits; enforce freshness before use in an offer or authority decision.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Pending followup ranking is applied after an incompatible limit
problem: Database lexical order is high/low/medium, then limit; Python reranks the already limited result. Medium tasks can be excluded behind low tasks before the intended priority order is applied.
fix: Order by a numeric priority rank inside the database before limiting and add due-time/lease filtering.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Administrative APIs have no application authentication
problem: No auth middleware/dependencies protect lead/property/call/intel/workflow/campaign routes. An isolated unauthenticated property read returns 200. Mutations and spend-bearing operations use server DB/provider privileges. An external gateway could add protection, but none is established by repository deployment configuration.
fix: Require authenticated operator sessions and role checks; verify read/mutation/eval/call routes with unauthenticated and least-privileged clients.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Telephony/SMS webhooks and media sockets are unauthenticated
problem: SignalWire HTTP callbacks/SMS and WebSocket endpoints accept supplied identifiers/payloads without signature/token validation. Boss mode relies on caller From matching the owner number, which is not trustworthy when an HTTP form can be forged.
fix: Verify signed HTTP requests and bind short-lived authenticated WebSocket tokens to call/stream IDs. Validate event origin, replay window and call ownership.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Dashboard ingest endpoints accept arbitrary writes
problem: The Next routes have no ingest authentication, can use SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY server-side, and ignore returned Supabase errors. They can announce ok:true even when an insert fails. The service key is not browser-exposed by this code; the risk is an unprotected server endpoint.
fix: Authenticate event producers, validate schemas, enforce replay/idempotency and check returned DB errors before acknowledging.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: SendGrid webhook accepts missing signatures and uses the wrong algorithm
problem: Missing headers bypass verification; no secret and verification exceptions allow requests. Verification uses hex HMAC-SHA256, while SendGrid signed event webhooks use ECDSA with a public key over timestamp plus raw body (official source linked below).
fix: Use the official verification helper with required headers/public key and a replay policy; fail closed and test valid/invalid/absent signatures.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Email opt-out link imports a nonexistent verifier
problem: The unsubscribe route imports verify_unsubscribe_token from alerts.email, where it is absent. A generated link can fail before applying opt-out. Spamreport handling calls nonexistent ComplianceEngine.handle_opt_out after pausing drips.
fix: Implement and test generation/verification/application of unsubscribe tokens and spam-report state changes with no live sends.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Compliance verification fails open
problem: Lead/compliance exceptions yield allowed=True; DNC lookup exceptions return False. A total DB failure may be blocked later by an independent lead fetch, but a DNC-only failure with usable lead data can still pass. SMS send_sms itself checks hours but does not invoke per-lead opt-out/DNC verification.
fix: Distinguish verified-safe, blocked and unknown; block outbound side effects when verification is unknown and centralize checks at send/dial boundaries.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Database access policies are not represented in migrations
problem: No tracked migration enables RLS or defines policies. Dashboard uses an anon client directly. The live database may have external policies, so this is missing deployment assurance, not proof that deployed data is publicly readable.
fix: Export reviewed RLS/grant policies into versioned migrations and run anon/operator/service-role access tests against an isolated database.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Costly endpoints lack authentication and bounded budgets
problem: Eval count/limits have no upper bounds and routes are unprotected; simulation uses paid model calls. Long uploads are fully read before size rejection. These create resource/billing amplification paths in the repository service.
fix: Add auth, request-size enforcement, rate limits, bounded counts and per-job budgets before provider calls.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Cross-origin dashboard requests have no server CORS policy
problem: No CORS middleware/proxy is configured. An isolated browser-style PATCH preflight returns 405 without allow-origin. This breaks a separate-origin dashboard/backend deployment; a same-origin deployment would avoid that particular failure.
fix: Configure exact permitted origins or a same-origin API proxy and verify production-origin GET, PATCH, upload and credentials behavior.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Live-call list is based on a context map emptied at stream start
problem: Inbound stream pops call_contexts during connection; outbound stream does not add its active context there. live API lists that map, even though call_metrics/start times are populated elsewhere. Active calls can disappear from operator monitoring.
fix: Maintain one active-session registry with lifecycle states, and distinguish pending context handoff from active sessions.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: User-turn events use the wrong call-ID attribute
problem: CallContext stores _call_sid but turn emission reads call_sid and only emits when nonempty. Normal user-turn events are silently skipped. Karpathys posts /api/v1/ingest whereas local dashboard handlers are /api/ingest; if dashboard is the intended receiver, a route adapter is missing.
fix: Use one typed event envelope and documented receiver routes; test the complete emitter-to-ingest contract with IDs and authentication.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Call metrics cleanup is not exception-safe
problem: Cleanup follows await run_sophia_agent instead of being in finally. The confirmed startup exception skips it, leaking stale session metrics/start times. Other untracked opener/emitter tasks can outlive the call.
fix: Own all session tasks in a task group and put registry/lease/timer cleanup in finally; test startup, provider and disconnect failures.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Post-call processing is nondurable fire-and-forget work
problem: QA and transcript intel/workflow tasks are created without a durable job record/awaited shutdown lifecycle. A restart can lose extraction, workflow transitions, alerts and substantive memory updates after the call row is inserted.
fix: Persist post-call jobs in an outbox with idempotent consumers and retry states; test restart between transcript persistence and extraction.
repair_status: Partial; post-call tasks now awaited; durable crash recovery remains

title: Unknown inbound callers have no equivalent durable call record
problem: _handle_call_end persists the call and schedules QA/intel only when a known lead exists. A new seller calling in without matched lead context can lose the transcript and follow-up opportunity.
fix: Persist every call with nullable lead association, then create/associate a lead through a verified intake flow.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Health responses do not prove a working voice session
problem: Most checks only detect a configured key, cartesia is checked although live TTS is Deepgram, root /health always says ok, and /api/health returns HTTP200 for degraded status. A call-start crash can coexist with a successful deploy health check.
fix: Separate liveness/readiness and verify the active provider configuration plus offline pipeline startup; return suitable readiness status on essential failures.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Blocking database/provider calls run in async API and call paths
problem: Many async routes use sync Supabase execute directly. Call-end SMS and packet refresh also perform blocking work. Such paths share the event loop with streaming sessions and can delay audio despite a fast DSP benchmark.
fix: Use async clients or bounded thread pools and explicit deadlines; measure event-loop lag under mixed API/audio load.
repair_status: Partial; follow-up work remains

title: Two source pages own the root route
problem: app/page.tsx and app/(dashboard)/page.tsx both resolve to /. Build succeeded with placeholder Supabase configuration and selected a server route, so this is ambiguous/shadowed ownership, not a demonstrated build failure. The client-marked CommandPage is also async, an unsupported client-component pattern if selected.
fix: Keep one root owner and explicit server/client boundaries; test which component is actually served in a browser.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Followup count queries a column absent from its schema
problem: Morning briefing filters followups.status while migration/DB functions use state. Returned Supabase errors are not surfaced here, so broken queries look like zero pending tasks.
fix: Use the canonical column and show failed/loading/empty distinctly; add a schema-backed dashboard data test.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Settings scores and connection labels are hardcoded
problem: QA values, provider Connected labels and Langfuse status are literals. Run Evals has no action handler, and Full Prompt points to health. The global sidebar says Sophia active independently of real health.
fix: Bind indicators/buttons to actual backend state and active prompt version; label unavailable data honestly.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: New Lead action points into a detail route
problem: No tracked /leads/new page exists; the dynamic [id] route can interpret new as a lead ID. Operator navigation promises creation without a matching creation flow.
fix: Implement a validated create screen or point the action to the existing supported ingestion flow.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: API failures are often rendered as ordinary empty state
problem: fetchAPI and multiple data pages swallow errors. Missing API URL falls back to same-origin /api requests although Next has no backend proxy for most routes. Operators cannot distinguish no leads/calls from broken wiring.
fix: Require endpoint configuration and surface actionable errors, retry controls and last successful refresh.
repair_status: Open; not established as repaired

title: Manual grade endpoint returns an unawaited coroutine
problem: grade_call is async, but the endpoint does not await it. Returned scores is a coroutine, so grading is not executed and response serialization is invalid.
fix: Await grading or enqueue a durable job and return its status/ID. Test the actual HTTP response.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Simulator crashes when grading its first conversation
problem: run_simulation also calls async grade_call without await, then calls .get on the coroutine. Offline model stubs reproduce AttributeError. /evals/run uses this simulator, so the deployed eval path is broken.
fix: Await and isolate grading; test full batch execution with stubs before permitting paid evaluations.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Evaluations exercise different prompts and bypass the live system
problem: Simulator/eval_runner load system/scenarios/scripts prompts while live English calls use sophia_runtime.md. They do not run transport, STT, VAD, custom processors, actual tools or audio. Appointment is inferred from words such as confirmed instead of a real booking record.
fix: Reuse the exact runtime prompt/config and run protocol/audio/tool scenarios. Score appointments only from verified booking IDs and agreement evidence.
repair_status: Partial; live opener, prompt, model default and conversation policy shared; speech, tools and full pipeline evaluation remain

title: Legacy eval runner imports nonexistent case helpers
problem: get_all_cases and get_cases_by_category are absent from eval_cases. This alternate evaluator cannot import, separately from the simulator async defect.
fix: Remove the obsolete runner or define one canonical case API and exercise it in CI.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: QA metric names do not match the values stored
problem: Qualification is filled from opener_natural, offer quality from reacted_before_asking, and appointment booking from motivation_discovered. Tone/goal completion columns are not populated. UI/metrics labels therefore misrepresent what is measured.

title: Full regression suite cannot collect
problem: Two test modules import removed spoken_renderer and halt collection. After excluding them, 214 pass and 12 fail: offer-contract tests, currency conflict detection, deleted identity/emotion symbols and one DB-dependent fallback test.
fix: Restore one valid suite and remove stale imports only with replacement coverage of the behaviors. Require complete collection and passing isolated tests in CI.

title: Tests fail to enforce actual assembled wiring
problem: The existing tests did not prevent the global call-start exception, missing context slots, wrong stream ID or interruption text retention. Testing individual components and fabricated safety lists cannot establish a working conversation.
fix: Add assembled-pipeline frame tests, model-request context assertions, schema-backed integrations and deterministic adversarial timelines. Keep the included reproductions as regression inputs, not assertions that broken behavior is desired.
repair_status: Addressed in repair branch; production verification pending

title: Live-provider latency script is included in default discovery
problem: Default pytest discovery can collect scripts/latency_test.py as well as tests/. It contains provider-oriented async checks without a clearly isolated offline marker/configuration. A generic test run can mix environment failures with application regressions.

title: Backend dependencies are unpinned and setup template is empty
problem: requirements.txt has no version constraints/lock; .env.example is zero bytes despite at least 51 Python env names found. Audit environment is Python3.12 vs project guidance3.11. Selected installed SignalWire/Twilio, Pipecat and Supabase distributions reported incompatible aiohttp/PyJWT requirements; a clean all-requirements environment was not established.

title: Dashboard lint has 55 errors and 10 warnings
problem: npm run lint exits nonzero with 65 findings. Most are unsafe any types, navigation and render purity. Next build succeeds with placeholder environment; passing compilation does not validate authenticated data or product behavior.

title: Duplicate definitions and warning-only failures obscure behavior
problem: Critical Ruff scan reports 12 undefined/redefined/local-shadow findings. Several definitions override older implementations, and broad exception handling reduces integration failures to warnings or success-like empty results. Compileall passes because syntax validity does not check these contracts.
fix: Remove overridden implementations, make unavailable/failed/empty states explicit, and treat critical static checks as required validation.

category: Additional voice checks from second pass
title: Seller named Claude triggers a fresh introduction
problem: The leakage filter matches the seller name Claude and replaces the entire answer with a cold introduction. A scheduling confirmation becomes Did I catch you at an okay time? Ordinary maximum-offer discussion can also trigger the reset.

category: Additional voice checks from second pass
title: Silence exit sets a flag without terminating the session
problem: After the final recovery phrase the silence timer sets call_should_end, resets its counter and returns; it does not cancel the pipeline or hang up. A silent seller produces no new turn to run the orchestrator, and the separate tool cancellation path is already broken.
fix: Call the trusted idempotent session termination callback directly after playback completes. Test a completely silent seller with no later tool or transcription event.

category: Additional voice checks from second pass
title: Speech text buffers are unbounded when completion never arrives
problem: SpeechChunker and SentenceStreamProcessor have no maximum buffer size or generation deadline. A missing full-response-end event can retain text indefinitely. The risk is visible in source; provider-driven unbounded output was not generated in this audit.
fix: Bound generation bytes/duration, flush valid incremental units and clear on cancel/error/new generation. Test missing-end and oversized-frame sequences.

title: Expired callback workers could clear newer claims
